name: wordpress-studio
description: Manage local WordPress sites via WordPress Studio
long_description: Control your local WordPress sites directly from Claude. List, start, stop, create, and delete sites. Read and write site files. Run WP-CLI commands. Create and manage preview sites on WordPress.com. Requires WordPress Studio to be installed.

tools.name: site_list
tools.description: List all WordPress sites in Studio

tools.name: site_status
tools.description: Get detailed status of a WordPress site

tools.name: site_set
tools.description: Update settings for a WordPress site

tools.name: fs_list_dir
tools.description: List files inside a WordPress site

tools.name: fs_read_file
tools.description: Read a file inside a WordPress site

tools.name: fs_write_file
tools.description: Write content to a file inside a WordPress site

tools.name: fs_delete
tools.description: Delete a file or directory inside a WordPress site

tools.name: wp
tools.description: Run a WP-CLI command on a running WordPress site

tools.name: preview_list
tools.description: List preview sites for a WordPress site

tools.name: preview_create
tools.description: Create a preview site from a WordPress site
